transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this recovery huddle started. As we all know, robotic palletizer P-4 went down during the morning shift, and we've got an urgent outbound order due at the end of the week. We have the manual palletizing station in the finished-goods warehouse available as a temporary alternative. Before I make a decision on the recovery method, I need to hear from each of you on your current findings. Let's go through maintenance work, shipment staging requirements, and energy-isolation controls. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: I'll start with maintenance. My inspection this morning found a damaged gearbox bearing in P-4. The good news is the replacement seal is stocked on site, and the repair will take exactly 6 hours with exactly 6 lockout points. The formal maintenance report is still awaiting my supervisor's signoff, but I wanted to get these findings in front of everyone now so we can plan accordingly.
